text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly bought on Friday 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp, company officials said. Of the total, Cheiljedang bought 8,500 tonnes at basis prices over September futures on the U.S. grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade. Dongah bought the remaining 13,000 tonnes at fixed prices. Shipment was set for July 20-August 20 to the southeastern port of Pusan.

CORN SALE - The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday said private exporters reported sales of 109,728 tonnes of corn to Japan. USDA said of the total, 54,864 tonnes is for delivering during the 1996/97 marketing year (Sept/Aug) and 54,864 tonnes is for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.

FEED SALE - South Korea's Feed Buying Group bought 27,500 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal from G.Premjee at between $140.61 and $141.61 a tonne C&F. The buyers group also bought 9,300 tonnes of Chinese cottonseed meal, 3,200 tonnes of Thai tapioca hard pellet and 3,000 tonnes of Chinese wheat bran pellet. Arrival dates ranged from July 25 to October 20.

SUNOIL SALE - Russia has been in the market for Argentine sunflower seed oil and is looking for more, Argentine traders said. "We sold 15,500 tonnes of sunflower seed oil for July to the Russians," one trader told Reuters, "In May we sold them 10,500 tonnes and they are looking for more sunseed oil." The trader declined to give the price of the operations, but said Argentine sunflower seed oil was currently offered at about $533 for July shipment and bid at $523.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it was tendering on June 17 for up to 5,080 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Kenya. Shipment was slated for July 1-25.

WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - The CCC said it is tendering on June 19 for up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Armenia. The wheat was slated for June 30-July 15 shipment. The tender was in combination with another for 1,500 to 2,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 program, Title One. Shipment on the second tender was also June 30-July 15 with offers also due on June 19.

- Guyana was tendering on Thursday for 2,300 tonnes of spring wheat, 1,000 tonnes of soft red winter and 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter under the PL-480 program, agents for the buyer said. Shipment was slated for July 4-26.

RICE TENDER - The Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) invited bids by June 16 for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati variety Pak-7 1996/97 (July-June) rice containing seven percent broken.

VEGOIL AND TALLOW TENDERS - El Salvador seeks 4,500 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and about 1,000 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 export program for July 20-August 5 shipment. Offers are to be received by June 16. El Salvador also seeks on June 16 about 1,650 tonnes of tallow and approximately 800 tonnes of top white tallow. Shipment dates were set for July 20-August 5.
CORN/BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission said it invited tenders for 18,000 tonnes of corn and 25,000 tonnes of barley for shipment in July. The tenders close June 17.
MARKET TALK - A senior grain official said the Turkish government was planning to impose a higher tax on corn imports effective from autumn this year.

South Korean civic groups on Friday donated an additional 30,000 tonnes of corn to famine-threatened North Korea. Seven religious and other civic groups said in a joint statement the supply would be on top of 50,000 tonnes of food being shipped to the communist state by the South Korean Red Cross.
